description: This file implements the CookieDeletionInfo class and related functions for managing cookie deletion criteria, including domain matching and time range filtering.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo
classes.description: Represents criteria for deleting cookies, including time range, domain filters, and cookie properties.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange
classes.description: Defines a time interval with start and end times for cookie deletion filtering.

methods.name: DomainMatchesDomains
methods.description: Checks if the cookie's domain matches any domain in a set of target domains.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange::TimeRange
methods.description: Constructs a TimeRange with optional start and end times.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange::Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given time falls within the TimeRange.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::Matches
methods.description: Determines if a given cookie matches the deletion criteria.
